headline: Wonder Egg
title: Wonder Egg | Guaranteed Alpha Or Sparkling | Aniimo Guide
video_script: Want a guaranteed rare Aniimo? The Wonder Egg hatches into an Aniimo with at least the Alpha or Sparkling mutation. One way to get it is the Homeland quest A Grand Feast, where you cook dishes for Jojo at home. You can also earn it from Nurture Branch progress and Holo-Battle Interlink. Then put it in a Hatchinator and wait. Have you hatched a Wonder Egg? Comment below!
description: The Wonder Egg hatches into an Aniimo with at least the Alpha or Sparkling mutation. The Homeland quest A Grand Feast, Nurture Branch and Holo-Battle Interlink can give one.
joke: Dinner for Jojo, and a surprise egg for dessert.
